calibration_tolerance.name: slopes-0.90-1.10-bands-30-5pp-v1
calibration_tolerance.rule: Logistic calibration slope (logit P(outcome) = a + b logit(p), fitted per outcome) of the home and of the away probability both between 0.90 and 1.10 inclusive, and no outcome probability band (home, draw and away, tenths of probability) with at least 30 matches more than 5 percentage points from its observed rate.

notes: Development (1 Aug 2022 - 30 Jun 2025) is primary; validation (to 15 Jan 2026) is secondary and was already inspected by earlier diagnostics. No holdout or retrospective row is read.
mean_gain > 0 means the first-named candidate (C6 in X_vs_Y) has the lower log loss: Y minus X.
Intervals resample whole calendar weeks (2,000 draws, seed 136, evaluation_harness.paired).
Calibration slope > 1 means the forecasts are too flat (outcomes more extreme than forecast).
Calibration tolerance: evaluation_harness.calibration_check with the configured rule, on every forecast of the candidate in the period; it matches results.json calibration_tolerance_check.
Favourite: the side with the higher of the home and away probabilities.
